Anthropic is changing the rules of code review. What happens when AI agents write the code?

As Claude Code agents contribute more to its codebase, Anthropic’s team combines automated verification, AI-powered reviews, and risk-based human approval to reduce manual review time without increasing regressions or production incidents.
